start: AI Assistant open; the gym has credits and has used some

steps.action: Tap the credits pill ('{n} credits') at the top
user_sees: Sheet 'AI credits'
'You have' and the balance in large figures
When there are free monthly credits: '{n} of them are this month's free credits. They are used first and end on {day}.'
'Your plan gets {n} free credits every month.' on a yearly plan
must_not: A balance typed into the app instead of the server's
Free credits shown as more than the balance
'1 credits'

user_sees: 'Message sent, member or payment saved' — '1 credit'
'Workout plan saved' — '3 credits'
Questions and speaking marked 'Free' (or '{n} for 1 credit' where the server counts them)
must_not: Pack prices or a Buy button
A price that differs from what a card charges

user_sees: Up to 8 lines, each with what the task did and +n or −n
must_not: A spend with no words
A plus sign on a spend

user_sees: The sheet closes and Help and feedback opens
must_not: A request sent to MettleUp by itself
Credits added at once

start: A draft card that needs more credits than the gym has

steps.action: Tap the button on the card that asks for credits
user_sees: The 'AI credits' sheet opens
must_not: The task saved without enough credits
The balance going below 0

user_sees: Help and feedback opens
must_not: The draft lost without a word

start: A gym with 0 credits on a monthly plan, not in trial

user_sees: '0 credits'
A warning: 'You have no credits left. Questions stay free.' (or the members line where members' answers use credits)
'Yearly plans get free credits every month.'
must_not: A minus balance
A promise of free monthly credits on a monthly plan
A free-credits line with 0 in it

steps.action: Look for 'Recently used' when nothing was ever used
user_sees: The section is not shown
must_not: An empty heading with nothing under it

start: AI credits sheet open with a known balance

steps.action: Close the sheet, send a drafted message from its card
user_sees: The pill drops by 1 at once
must_not: The pill unchanged until a reload
Two credits taken for one send

user_sees: The new balance
A new top line in 'Recently used' with what the task did and −1
must_not: The old balance
A line that only says 'A task' when the task is known

steps.action: Have a task fail after it took a credit, open the sheet again
user_sees: 'Credits given back' with +1 and the balance restored
must_not: The credit kept for a task that did not work

steps.action: On the last day of the month note the free credits; open the sheet on the 1st
user_sees: 'Unused free credits ended' and 'Free credits for this month'
must_not: Unused free credits carried over
Bought credits removed

start: Owner and a staff login of the same gym

user_sees: This gym's balance and its own recent lines
must_not: Another gym's balance or lines

steps.action: As staff or trainer look for the pill or the sheet
user_sees: Neither is shown
must_not: Staff seeing the balance or what the owner asked
The demo gym showing a real balance
